content.title: American Airlines stock tumbles, Nucor misses Q4 sales estimates
content.description:
Market Domination Host Josh Lipton tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including American Airlines (AAL) shares tumbling after missing fourth quarter profit estimates tied to the US government shutdown, JetBlue Airways (JBLU) hitting some turbulence in its turnaround strategy, and steel manufacturer Nucor (NUE) reporting lower-than-expected sales volumes.

content.title: American Airlines Flight Cancellations Persist as Rivals Move Past Winter Storm
content.summary: Airlines have largely recovered from winter storm Fern’s snow and ice, but American Airlines continues to struggle.  As of midafternoon, more than 950 American flights scheduled for Tuesday have been scrapped.  Regional carrier PSA Airlines, which operates American-branded flights, has shed over a quarter of its schedule.
